ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can identify pests and diseases and drones can scan entire fields, but technicians still need to feel the soil and explain recommendations clearly to farmers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 18,600 agricultural technicians employed in 2024, rising to a projected 19,400 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 800 jobs and about 2,900 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $46,800 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace agricultural technicians, but it will change how they work. AI and smart equipment increasingly handle soil data, remote-sensing imagery, and pest identification, shifting technicians from recording data toward interpreting it, exercising field judgment, and implementing extension programs. Machines cannot replace site assessment or farmer communication. Technicians who understand data and work effectively in fields become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI pest and disease recognition supports field judgment
Widespread drone field scouting and crop-growth monitoring
Automated smart irrigation and fertilizer control
Big-data guidance for varieties and fertilization plans
ai_s2_auto: Automated soil and weather data collection
Automated remote-sensing image recognition and analysis
ai_s3_list: On-site field judgment: assess soil, crop growth, and pests beyond the data.
Experimental execution: people control errors in plot planting, sampling, and yield measurement.
Farmer communication and trust: extension works only when technology is clear and credible.
Emergency response: people handle sudden weather changes and pest outbreaks in the field.
Connect data with production: even the best report requires field validation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means automation is taking over about half of desk-based work. AI and software assist with records, analysis, and reports.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI handles data tasks, making field judgment, experimental execution, and technical extension more important. Pure record-analysis roles shrink, while technicians who work in fields and communicate effectively become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study agronomy, plant protection, horticulture, or agricultural resources and environment and seek internships at research institutes and agricultural parks. Develop both field and data-analysis skills rather than remaining only in the laboratory.

Use drones, smart sensors, and AI recognition tools and take responsibility for technical-extension projects. Progress from recording data to a hybrid role in data, fieldwork, and extension, and pursue agronomist credentials.

An agriculture or biology background is ideal, but people without one can enter through technical-assistant roles at agricultural input companies. On your resume, specify experiments conducted, indicators measured, and farmers advised.

Do not hire technicians based only on education. Evaluate willingness to work in fields and extension ability. Candidates who work directly with crops, communicate with farmers, and interpret data are the scarcest combination.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Remote sensing of crop growth and pest scouting
Integrate weather, soil, and yield data

ai_s7_trends: Smart-agriculture equipment and AI analysis shift technicians from recording data toward interpreting it and exercising field judgment, making data analysis a foundational skill.
Seed-industry revitalization and food security support demand for local agricultural technology, especially technicians who implement and communicate solutions.
Agricultural service organizations expand, shifting technicians toward hybrid technology-service and business roles.

body: Agricultural technicians support research and production experiments by collecting and testing soil and crop samples, conducting variety and fertilizer trials, recording and analyzing growth data, and advising farmers.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can identify pests and diseases and drones can scan entire fields, but technicians still need to feel the soil and explain recommendations clearly to farmers.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动识别病虫害、无人机能扫整片田，但蹲在地里摸一把土、跟农户把话讲透的那个人，还得是你。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年农业技术员在岗约 1.86 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.94 万人，净增约 0.08 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.29 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.68 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代农业技术员，但会改变工作方式。土壤数据、遥感影像、病虫害识别正被 AI 和智能设备接管，技术员从「记录数据」转向「解读数据、现场判断、推广落地」。田间的实地判断和与农户的沟通，是机器替代不了的——懂数据又会下田的技术员反而更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 病虫害识别辅助田间判断
无人机巡田与长势监测普及
智能水肥系统自动调控
大数据指导品种与施肥方案
ai_s2_auto: 土壤与气象数据自动采集
试验记录与报告电子化
遥感影像自动识别分析
ai_s3_list: 田间实地判断：土壤、长势、病虫害，数据之外的现场感觉。
试验执行的手艺：小区试验的播种、取样、测产，误差靠人控制。
与农户的沟通信任：技术讲得懂、听得进，推广才落地。
突发情况的应变：天气突变、虫害暴发，田间处置靠人。
数据与生产的结合：报告写得再好，也要到地里验证。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半桌面任务正被自动化——记录、分析、报告，AI 和软件都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接管的是「数据」环节，留下的是「现场」环节——田间判断、试验执行和技术推广反而更重要。真正被压缩的是纯记录分析岗，会下田、会推广的技术员更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选农学、植保、园艺或农业资源环境专业，假期多去科研院所和园区实习。把田间技能和数据分析都练起来，别只坐在实验室。
把无人机、智能传感和 AI 识别工具用起来，主动承担技术推广项目。从「记录数据」升级为「数据+田间+推广」三合一，考农艺师职称。
有农学或生物基础最好，无背景可从农资企业技术助理切入。简历上多写「做过哪些试验、测过哪些指标、指导过多少农户」。
招技术员别只看学历，要看下田意愿和推广能力。能蹲田里、能跟农户说话、又看得懂数据的候选人，是最稀缺的组合。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 气象、土壤、产量数据整合

ai_s7_trends: 智慧农业设备与 AI 分析普及，技术员从「记录数据」转向「解读数据、做现场判断」，数据分析能力成为基础技能。
种业振兴与粮食安全推动基层农技需求，会推广、能落地的技术员更抢手。
农业社会化服务组织扩张，技术员向「技术服务+经营」复合角色转变。

body: 农业技术员负责农业科研与生产的试验支持，包括土壤与作物样本采集检测、品种与肥料试验执行、生长数据记录分析，以及面向农户的技术指导。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated valuation models can produce neighborhood averages in seconds, but an appraiser still decides how to adjust for a leaking penthouse and who signs the report and accepts responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 77,300 real estate appraisers and assessors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 80,200 by 2034, a net gain of about 2,900 jobs, with roughly 6,300 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $65,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace real estate appraisers, but it will accelerate preliminary valuations and data work. Online valuations and automated models speed up standard estimates. Appraisers can focus on site inspections, unusual-property adjustments, signed reports, and complex-property valuation. Standard preliminary estimates face the most automation, while licensed professionals with sound judgment become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automated valuation models estimate average prices
Property brochure and report template generation
ai_s3_list: Site inspection: people verify actual conditions.
Unusual factors: people determine adjustments.
Complex properties: people choose the method.
Signed accountability: people own the conclusion.
Dispute testimony: people appear in court.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this career in the moderate exposure range for preliminary valuation. Systems accelerate data analysis and average-price estimates, while inspections and signed conclusions remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high career risk. AI replaces standard preliminary estimates and data searches, not the licensed role that determines and signs a value. Licensed appraisers with strong judgment become more scarce as tools improve efficiency. Template-only estimators face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in real estate or valuation and work extensively with data and regulations while studying. Standard preliminary estimates are shrinking in the AI era, so practice inspections early.
Move beyond templates toward inspections and complex-property assignments. Learn the income approach and expert testimony, then pursue licensing authority to sign reports.
Highlight appraisal reports and site-visit cases. State clearly which properties you have worked on. Firms value consistency and accuracy.
Do not assess candidates by calculation skills alone. Evaluate whether they can accept responsibility for a signed conclusion. Appraisers who conduct strong inspections merit higher incentive pay.

ai_s7_trends: Automated valuation improves efficiency, reducing preliminary-estimate work.
Mortgage lending and property taxation still require valuations.
Licensed appraisers with inspection skills are in greater demand.

body: Real estate appraisers and assessors use site inspections, market data, and valuation methods to provide objective opinions of value for homes, commercial properties, and land. Their work supports transactions, mortgages, taxation, and disputes as an independent asset-pricing function.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated valuation models can produce neighborhood averages in seconds, but an appraiser still decides how to adjust for a leaking penthouse and who signs the report and accepts responsibility.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动估价模型能秒给小区均价，但那套顶楼漏水的特殊因素怎么折算、报告谁签字担责，还是估价师的眼和笔定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年评估师评估员房地产在岗约 7.73 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 8.02 万人，净增约 0.29 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.63 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.54 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代房地产估价师，但会加速初估与数据。在线估价和自动模型把标准初估提速，估价师从「查数据」挪向「现场勘查、特殊因素判断、报告签字与复杂物业估值」。真正被挤掉的是标准初估，持牌会判断的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场勘查：真况靠人看。
特殊因素：折算靠人。
复杂物业：方法靠人定。
签字责任：结论靠人。
纠纷质证：出庭靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的初估区——数据与均价被系统加速，但勘查与签字还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准初估与查数据」动作，不是「定价签字」的岗位。持牌、会判断的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会套模板出均价的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 房地产/评估打底，在校多摸数据与法规。AI 时代标准初估在缩，早点练勘查。
从「套模板」升级成「做勘查 + 复杂物业」，学收益法与质证，争取持牌签字。
突出报告与踩盘案例，写清跟过哪些物业。机构看重稳和准。
选人别只看会算，要看敢不敢签字。能勘查的估价师，值得给高提成。

ai_s7_trends: 自动估价提效，初估缩。
抵押征税仍刚需。
持牌会勘查的更缺。

body: 房地产估价师与评估员通过现场勘查、市场数据与估价方法，对住宅、商业与土地给出客观价值意见，用于交易、抵押、征税与纠纷，是资产定价的中立角色。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动估价模型能秒给小区均价，但那套顶楼漏水的特殊因素怎么折算、报告谁签字担责，还是估价师的眼和笔定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Uncrewed combat vehicles can take over some reconnaissance and strike tasks, but people still direct crew coordination, judgment, and backup decisions in complex terrain.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. military pay follows the Department of Defense rank and years-of-service system. Civilian BLS OES data does not cover military occupations, so this page does not provide a U.S. median. Salary references use Chinese mainland proxy data (Aiqicha and other public sources, sample of 10, 2026-08).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace armored vehicle crew members, but it will change crew positions. Remote operation and uncrewed vehicles will gradually absorb some standardized tasks. Crew members can shift from single-function operation toward crew coordination, field judgment, and command of uncrewed platforms. Single-task operators face the most pressure, while people who lead crews and understand coordination become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Crew coordination: people build teamwork through practice.
Field judgment: people decide during unexpected events.
Complex terrain: people make tradeoffs.
Performance under pressure: people stay composed in disorder.
Uncrewed platform command: people make decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 3/10 score places this career in the relatively low AI exposure range. Field coordination and operational judgment are difficult to replace in the near term, while automation mainly affects some standardized tasks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not mean no change. Uncrewed systems will alter crew structures over time, but field execution and coordination remain human-led. People who only perform a single function and do not learn coordination face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build physical fitness and discipline before enlistment. Single-function work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop crew coordination early.
Move beyond a single crew position toward leading a crew and understanding uncrewed platforms. Learn operational awareness and command.
Highlight discipline and coordination experience. State clearly which crew positions and missions you supported. Civilian employers value reliability and resilience.
Do not assess candidates by physical fitness alone. Evaluate discipline and coordination. Experienced members who lead a crew are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Uncrewed combat vehicles are spreading and changing crew positions.
Crew coordination and command create opportunities.
People who understand uncrewed platforms are in greater demand.

body: Armored Assault Vehicle Crew Members work as coordinated crew members in military armored vehicles, performing driving, loading, aiming, firing, and communications duties to support vehicle mobility and firepower as the field execution force of ground assault.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Uncrewed combat vehicles can take over some reconnaissance and strike tasks, but people still direct crew coordination, judgment, and backup decisions in complex terrain.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 无人战车能替一部分侦察与打击，但车组在复杂地形里的协同、判断和兜底，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国军用薪酬由国防部等级制（军衔+年限）决定，民用 BLS OES 不统计军事职业，本页不提供美国中位数口径；薪资参考以中国大陆代理数据为准（爱企查等公开渠道，采样 10 条，2026-08）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代装甲车辆成员，但会改变战位。远程操控与无人战车在长期吃掉部分标准化操作，成员从「纯操作」挪向「车组协同、现场判断、无人平台指挥」。真正被挤掉的是只做单一操作的，能带车组、懂协同的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 车组协同：默契靠人练。
现场判断：突发靠人定。
复杂地形：取舍靠人。
压力兜底：乱中不崩。
指挥无人平台：决策靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光区——现场协同与实战判断短期难被系统替代，自动化主要影响部分标准操作。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化：无人化在长期会改战位结构，但车组的现场执行与协同仍留着人的位置。怕的是只守单一操作、不学协同的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 入伍前练体能和纪律，AI 时代单操作在缩，早点学车组协同。
从「单战位」升级成「带车组 + 懂无人平台」，学态势与指挥。
突出纪律与协同经验，写清战位与任务。地方看重稳和扛。
选人别只看体能，要看纪律和协同。能带车组的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 无人战车普及，改战位。
车组协同与指挥有机会。
懂无人平台的人更抢手。

body: 装甲突击车辆成员在军用装甲车辆上按战位协同执行驾驶、装填、瞄准、射击与通信任务，保障车辆机动与火力发挥，是地面突击的现场执行力量。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 无人战车能替一部分侦察与打击，但车组在复杂地形里的协同、判断和兜底，还是人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can quickly locate fault codes, but hangar decisions still require your signature: where a burned wiring harness shorted, whether to repair or replace a circuit board, and how to execute the next step in a modification drawing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 21,400 avionics technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 23,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,700 jobs, with approximately 1,800 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $81,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace avionics technicians, but it will upgrade their troubleshooting tools. Predictive maintenance, AI fault diagnosis, and data analysis accelerate troubleshooting, shifting technicians from manual investigation to AI-assisted localization, on-site confirmation, and complex fault isolation. Machines cannot replace airworthiness responsibility, complex diagnostic judgment, or modification work. Licensed technicians with strong technical skills become more secure.
ai_s2_auto: Automated generation of digital maintenance records
Automated test data collection and analysis
ai_s3_list: Complex fault judgment: identify hidden causes beyond the codes.
Hands and eyes for troubleshooting: use multimeters and oscilloscopes to trace wiring harnesses one conductor at a time.
Airworthiness responsibility: signing a release carries legal accountability.
Precision in modification work: follow drawings without missing a step.
Ability to learn new systems: keep avionics knowledge current as aircraft models change.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, means the troubleshooting and analysis portion of this career is becoming digital. AI can assist with fault interpretation, test analysis, and recordkeeping.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI assists with localization and analysis, while on-site confirmation, complex troubleshooting, and airworthiness signatures still depend on people. Pure data-recording roles face the most pressure, while licensed technicians who can resolve complex faults become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choose avionics, electronic engineering, or aircraft maintenance and pursue a maintenance license early. Strong English and electronic circuit fundamentals are essential because poor English makes technical manuals a barrier.

Learn AI troubleshooting, AR-assisted maintenance, and predictive maintenance systems, and actively take on complex faults. Earn release authority and advance toward avionics specialist or maintenance management roles.

An electronics or maintenance background is ideal. You can enter through an aircraft maintenance apprenticeship or line maintenance and then earn the required license. On your resume, specify the faults you resolved, aircraft types you know, and licenses you hold.

When hiring technicians, assess more than years of licensure. Look at troubleshooting logic and learning ability. Young technicians willing to learn AI tools are strong candidates for development into core avionics specialists.

ai_s7_trends: As AI diagnosis and predictive maintenance become widespread, technicians shift from manual troubleshooting to AI-assisted localization, on-site confirmation, and complex fault isolation. Data analysis becomes a standard skill.
Fleet expansion and aircraft model changes increase avionics maintenance demand, making licensed technicians who understand new aircraft types more sought after.
As AR assistance and digital twins enter service, technicians evolve into hybrid professionals combining AI tools, complex installation work, and airworthiness management.

body: Avionics technicians install, inspect, troubleshoot, and repair aircraft avionics systems, including navigation, communication, radar, autopilot, instruments, and electrical systems. They hold a critical aircraft maintenance role that protects flight safety.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can quickly locate fault codes, but hangar decisions still require your signature: where a burned wiring harness shorted, whether to repair or replace a circuit board, and how to execute the next step in a modification drawing.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你快速定位故障代码，但「线束烧了是哪里短路、这块板修还是换、改装图纸这一步怎么走」——机库里的决定，还得你签字。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年航空电子技术员在岗约 2.14 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.31 万人，净增约 0.17 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.18 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.14 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代航空电子技术员，但会升级排障工具。预测性维护、AI 故障诊断和数据分析正在加速排障流程，技术员从「手动排查」转向「AI 定位+现场确认+复杂排障」。适航责任、复杂故障判断和改装施工，是机器替代不了的核心——执照在身、技术过硬的技术员反而更稳。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助排障定位系统
AR 辅助维修指导普及
数字孪生维修仿真应用
ai_s2_auto: 维修记录电子化自动生成
测试数据自动采集分析
ai_s3_list: 复杂故障的判断：代码之外，能想到「隐性原因」。
排障的手与眼：万用表、示波器，线束一根根捋。
适航责任担当：签字放行，就是法律层面的负责。
改装施工的严谨：按图施工，一步不错。
新系统的学习力：机型换代，航电知识跟得上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的排障分析环节正在被数字化——故障解析、测试分析、记录，AI 都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 辅助的是「定位和分析」环节，现场确认、复杂排障和适航签字依然靠人。真正被压缩的是纯数据记录岗，持执照、会复杂排障的技术员反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选航空电子、电子工程或机务专业，尽早考维修执照。英语和电子电路基础必须扎实，英语差会被手册卡住。
把 AI 排障、AR 维修和预测性维护系统学起来，主动啃复杂故障。考取放行权，往航电专家和维修管理方向走。
有电子或维修背景最好，可从机务学徒或航线维护切入再考证照。简历上多写「处理过什么故障、会什么机型、有没有执照」。
招技术员别只看执照年限，要看排障思路和学习能力。愿意学 AI 工具的年轻人，值得培养成航电骨干。

ai_s7_trends: AI 诊断与预测性维护普及，技术员从「手动排障」转向「AI 定位+现场确认+复杂排障」，数据分析能力成为标配。
机队扩张与机型换代推动航电维护需求，持执照、懂新机型的航电技术员更抢手。
AR 辅助与数字孪生落地，技术员向「AI 工具+复杂施工+适航管理」复合角色转变。

body: 航空电子技术员负责飞机航电系统的安装、检测、排障与维修，涵盖导航、通信、雷达、自动驾驶、仪表与电气系统，是保障飞行安全的关键机务技术岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮你快速定位故障代码，但「线束烧了是哪里短路、这块板修还是换、改装图纸这一步怎么走」——机库里的决定，还得你签字。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AlphaFold can predict protein structures at atomic resolution, but biochemistry researchers still answer why a protein folds that way and what role it plays in disease.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 35,600 biochemists and biophysicists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 37,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,000 jobs, with approximately 2,900 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $103,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace biochemists and biophysicists, but it will redistribute their time. AI greatly accelerates literature searches, sequence analysis, structure prediction, and data organization, while tools such as AlphaFold have directly reshaped structural biology research. Researchers are freed from repetitive work to focus on asking strong questions, designing sound experiments, and interpreting results, precisely the areas where AI is weakest.
ai_s2_auto: Automated analysis of sequencing and omics data
Electronic experimental records and data archiving
Routine statistical analysis and chart generation
ai_s3_list: Formulating scientific questions: identify research-worthy problems at the frontier of knowledge.
Experimental design: break a question into testable experimental steps.
Interpreting results: distinguish signal from noise and anomalies from discoveries.
Interdisciplinary collaboration: communicate with computational, clinical, and chemistry teams.
Scientific communication: turn complex conclusions into papers and reports.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means the computational side of biochemical research is already deeply integrated with AI. Structure prediction, omics analysis, and literature processing are strengths of AI, but the true challenges of research, including hypothesis formation, experimental design, and result interpretation, depend on creative thinking and domain experience. AI can assist but cannot lead, which supports the score of 6.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure gives researchers an efficiency dividend. People who use AlphaFold and write code to process omics data can compress a year-long experimental cycle into a few months. Tools are accelerators, while scientific taste and judgment are the durable advantage.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Prepare for a long path into research. A bachelor's degree is only the beginning, followed by graduate school, a doctorate, and postdoctoral work that can require a decade of groundwork. Families need to support a child moving slowly while encouraging programming and data-analysis skills, because computational biology is a particularly promising direction.

Actively adopt AI tools for structure prediction, omics analysis, and automated literature management. Invest the saved time in experimental design and paper quality, while watching industry opportunities because pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies often offer more practical compensation.

Backgrounds in chemistry, biology, or physics can transfer into this field. Corporate research and development values practical ability, so bring completed projects and datasets to interviews. Computational specialties such as modeling and data analysis offer the widest transition opportunities.

Research talent is difficult to recruit and retain. The core offer is stable funding plus a clear promotion path, and multidisciplinary researchers who use AI tools and write code merit equity and flexible arrangements.

ai_s7_trends: Computational and wet-lab work integrate deeply, and AI predictions become standard research tools.
Synthetic biology and gene-therapy industries expand, increasing industry demand.
AI lowers barriers to research, increasing the value of experimental-design ability.

body: Biochemists and biophysicists apply chemical and physical principles to study the structure and function of biological macromolecules. They investigate life processes such as proteins, nucleic acids, and cellular metabolism in support of basic research, drug development, and biotechnology.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AlphaFold can predict protein structures at atomic resolution, but biochemistry researchers still answer why a protein folds that way and what role it plays in disease.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AlphaFold 能把蛋白结构预测到原子级别，但「这个蛋白为什么会这么折叠、它在疾病里扮演什么角色」，还是要生化研究者来回答。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年生物化学家与生物物理学家在岗约 3.56 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.76 万人，净增约 0.20 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.29 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.37 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代生物化学家与生物物理学家，但会重新分配他们的时间：文献检索、序列分析、结构预测、数据整理这些环节被 AI 大幅加速，AlphaFold 这类工具甚至直接改写了结构生物学的研究方式。研究者从「重复劳动」里解放出来，把精力放在提出好问题、设计好实验和解释结果上——这恰恰是 AI 最不擅长的部分。
ai_s2_accel: 蛋白质结构预测（AlphaFold 等）
AI 辅助药物靶点筛选
合成生物学自动化设计
实验机器人高通量操作
ai_s2_auto: 测序与组学数据的自动化分析
实验记录与数据归档电子化
常规统计分析与图表生成
ai_s3_list: 提出科学问题：在知识边界找到值得研究的点。
实验设计：把问题拆成可验证的实验步骤。
结果解读：区分信号与噪声、异常与发现。
跨学科协作：与计算、临床、化学团队沟通。
学术表达：把复杂结论讲成论文和报告。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明生化科研的「计算面」已经深度 AI 化：结构预测、组学分析、文献处理都是 AI 的主场；但科研真正的难点——假设提出、实验设计、结果解读——依赖创造性思维和领域经验，AI 只能辅助不能主导，所以是 6 分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光对研究者是「效率红利」：会用 AlphaFold、会写代码处理组学数据的人，能把一年实验周期压缩到几个月。工具是你的加速器，科学品味和判断力才是你的护城河。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走科研要准备长周期：本科只是入门，读研读博加博士后十年打底。家里要支持孩子「慢」，同时提醒他培养编程和数据分析能力，计算生物学是未来最吃香的方向。
主动拥抱 AI 工具：结构预测、组学分析、自动文献管理都用起来，把省下的时间投到实验设计和论文质量上；同时关注产业界机会，药企和生物技术公司给钱更实在。
有化学、生物、物理背景都可转；企业研发更看重实操能力，面试时带上你做过的项目和数据集，比学历更打动 HR；计算方向（建模、数据分析）转行空间最大。
科研人才难招难留，核心是给「稳定的经费和清晰的晋升路径」；会用 AI 工具、能写代码的复合型科研人才，值得用股权和弹性机制绑定。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 蛋白质结构高精度预测

ai_s7_trends: 计算与湿实验深度融合，AI 预测成为研究标配。
合成生物学与基因治疗产业扩张，产业界需求增长。
AI 降低科研门槛，实验设计能力反而更被看重。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Tools can run standard models, but biostatisticians still decide which endpoints to set and how to explain them to regulators.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 32,200 biostatisticians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 34,900 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,700 jobs, with approximately 2,000 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $103,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Biostatisticians, but it will compress standard analysis work. Automated modeling and open-source tools speed up routine analysis, shifting biostatisticians from running models toward trial design, regulatory communication, evidence judgment, and customized plans. Roles limited to standard modeling face displacement, while people with design and compliance skills become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Trial design: people set the endpoints.
Regulatory communication: people define the position.
Evidence judgment: people make the tradeoffs.
Solution customization: people uncover the pain points.
Building trust: people guide a submission through review.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 8/10 places this occupation in the relatively high AI-exposure range for statistical work. Systems accelerate standard analysis, while trial design and regulatory submissions still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively high exposure does not mean high risk. Standard modeling tasks are being replaced, not the occupation's trial-design and regulatory responsibilities. People who can design studies and explain evidence clearly become scarcer as efficiency improves. Those limited to standard models face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with statistics or biology and study more medicine and regulation. Pure modeling roles are shrinking in the AI era, so develop design skills early.
Advance from running models to designing plans and working with regulators. Learn trial methods and regulations.
Emphasize trial-statistics and submission experience, and clearly state which development phases you have supported.
Do not select candidates only by education; assess whether they think like study designers. Core staff who can navigate regulatory review merit higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Automation absorbs standard analysis.
Regulatory communication becomes more important.
Biostatisticians with design skills are in greater demand.

body: Biostatisticians (Biostatisticians) lead statistical design and analysis for clinical trials, coordinating protocols, data, and submissions. They use statistics and professional judgment to produce credible evidence that withstands regulatory review.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Tools can run standard models, but biostatisticians still decide which endpoints to set and how to explain them to regulators.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 工具能跑标准模型，但哪个终点该设、怎么讲给监管听，还是统计师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年生物统计学家在岗约 3.22 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.49 万人，净增约 0.27 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.20 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.33 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代生物统计师，但会压缩标准分析。自动化建模与开源工具把常规分析提速，统计师从「跑模型」挪向「试验设计、监管沟通、证据判断、方案定制」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准建模的，有设计力和合规力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 试验设计：终点靠人设。
监管沟通：口径靠人定。
证据判断：取舍靠人。
方案定制：痛点靠人挖。
信任建立：审查靠人过。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明这个职业处在高 AI 曝光的统计区——标准分析被系统加速，但设计与申报还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准建模」动作，不是「试验设计与监管」的岗位。有设计力、能把证据讲清楚的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会跑标准模型的统计。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 统计 / 生物起步多学医学与法规，AI 时代纯建模在缩，早点练设计。
从「跑模型」升级成「设方案 + 对监管」，学试验和法规。
突出试验统计和申报经验，写清跟过哪些阶段。
选人别只看学历，要看有没有设计脑子。能过监管的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 自动化吃标准分析。
监管沟通更被重。
有设计力的统计更抢手。

body: Biostatisticians（生物统计学家）主导临床试验的统计设计与分析，统筹协议、数据与申报，运用统计与专业判断保障证据可信、经得起监管审查。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate the most economical dredging route, but operators still need a practiced feel to decide how much force to apply to hard soil underwater.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,100 Dredge Operators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 1,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 100 jobs, with about 100 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $48,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Dredge Operators, but it will change how they work. Automated dredging systems can advance along a route and adjust depth using sediment data, freeing operators from constantly watching the controls. Human experience is still needed to judge underwater conditions, handle equipment abnormalities, and protect worksite safety.
ai_s2_accel: Sonar and computer vision AI identify underwater terrain and obstacles
Intelligent alerts for slurry-pump blockages and overloads
Centralized dispatch of multiple vessels from remote monitoring centers
Weather and hydrological data support operating decisions
ai_s2_auto: Automated dredging systems advance independently along preset routes and depths
Automatic collection and reporting of depth, flow rate, concentration, and other parameters
Automatic generation of digital operating logs and reports
Automated processing of positioning surveys and cross-section data
ai_s3_list: Judging underwater conditions: sonar images are a reference, but experience is needed to assess sediment hardness and hidden obstacles.
Handling equipment abnormalities: deciding when to stop for a blocked pipe, lost cutter, or tangled cable depends on hands-on expertise.
Managing worksite safety: water-based operations carry many risks, and a decision can affect everyone aboard.
Coordinating on site with survey crews, tugboats, and shore dispatchers: vital information is often conveyed through direct communication.
Building construction experience: operators learn through practice which sections require a slower pace and which allow faster work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means parameter monitoring, recordkeeping, and route execution make up a meaningful share of this occupation, and automation and AI systems are taking over these tasks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: However, low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Automation is shifting operators from watching instruments to managing systems and diagnosing abnormalities. Entry-level roles limited to mechanical control work face the most pressure, while experienced operators who understand equipment and can resolve failures become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study a maritime, port and waterway, or mechanical discipline, earn the required certificates, and seek as much onboard training as possible. Operators who can use automated systems and repair equipment are scarce in the AI era, so do not learn vessel operation alone.

Build skills in automated dredging systems and remote monitoring, along with basic electrical and hydraulic maintenance. Move from equipment operator to equipment steward; this combination is especially valuable on overseas projects.

A mechanical or marine background is an advantage. Earn certificates first and then gain onboard experience. On your resume, describe specific work such as independently completing a project section or resolving an equipment failure instead of making vague claims about working hard.

Do not hire on certificates alone; assess emergency response skills. Ask candidates how they would diagnose and clear a blocked slurry pump. This filters out people who can only start the machinery. Candidates with automated-system and maintenance experience merit stronger offers.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic route advancement and depth adjustment
Coordination of vessel status with shore dispatch
Integration of wave, wind, and tide-level data
Automated logs, progress tracking, and reports

ai_s7_trends: Automated dredging and remote control are becoming widespread, shifting operators from watching controls to managing systems and diagnosing abnormalities.
Port projects and environmental sediment removal continue to grow, creating a clear premium for combined operating and maintenance skills.
Safety oversight is tightening, certificate and training requirements are rising, and unqualified work opportunities are shrinking.

body: Dredge Operators operate cutter-suction, trailing-suction, and other dredging equipment to remove underwater sediment and widen or deepen waterways to project specifications. They also monitor equipment and handle abnormalities during operations.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate the most economical dredging route, but operators still need a practiced feel to decide how much force to apply to hard soil underwater.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出最经济的挖泥路径，但水下那块硬土该下多重的手，还得靠操作员的手感。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年挖泥船操作员在岗约 0.11 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.12 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.01 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.84 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代挖泥船操作员，但会改变操作方式。自动疏浚系统能按航线自动推进、根据泥层数据调深度，把操作员从「一直盯着杆子」里解放出来。剩下的水下情况判断、设备异常处置、现场安全，还得靠人的经验。
ai_s2_accel: 声呐与影像 AI 识别水底障碍与地形
泥泵堵塞、过载的智能预警
远程监控中心多船集中调度
气象水文数据接入辅助作业决策
ai_s2_auto: 自动疏浚系统按设定航线与深度自主推进
深度、流速、浓度等参数自动采集上报
作业日志与报表电子化自动生成
定位测量与断面数据的自动化处理
ai_s3_list: 水下情况判断：声呐图是参考，底质软硬、有无障碍还得靠经验定。
设备异常处置：堵管、掉刀、钢丝缠绕，停机判断靠的是手上功夫。
现场安全把控：水上作业风险多，一个决定关系整船人。
与测量、拖轮和岸调的现场协作：传话带话之间全是信息。
施工经验的沉淀：哪些工段该慢、哪些能提速，是干出来的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的参数监测、记录和航线执行比重不小，这些正被自动化和 AI 系统接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。自动化把操作员从「盯仪表」升级为「管系统、判异常」，真正被挤压的是只会机械拉杆的新手岗；有经验、懂设备、能处理异常的资深操作员反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走海事、港航或机械类专业方向，把证书考扎实，多争取上船实习。AI 时代，会看自动化系统又能上手修设备的操作员稀缺，别只学「开船」。
把自动化疏浚系统和远程监控技能补起来，学点基础电气与液压维护。从「操作手」升级为「设备管家」，出海项目里更吃香。
有机械、船舶背景是加分项。先考证、再跟船，简历里多写「独立完成XX工段、处理过XX设备故障」这类具体事，比空泛的吃苦耐劳有用。
招人别只看证，要看应急处理。面试时问「泥泵堵了你怎么判断、怎么处置」，能筛掉只会开机的。有自动化系统经验、又懂维护的人值得高配。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 按航线自动推进、深度自动调节

ai_s7_trends: 自动化疏浚与远程操控普及，操作员从「盯杆子」转向「管系统、判异常」。
港口与生态清淤工程持续增长，复合型技能（操作 + 维护）溢价明显。
安全监管趋严，持证与培训要求提升，无资质作业空间收窄。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Drones can survey a forest from the air, but technicians still decide where to place plots, how to measure trees, and how to assess fire risk on the ground.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 33,800 Forest And Conservation Technicians employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 32,700 by 2034, a net loss of about 1,100 jobs, with roughly 3,900 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $54,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Forest And Conservation Technicians, but it will reduce routine field recording. Remote sensing, drones, and GIS accelerate patrols and mapping. Technicians are shifting from walking routes with a notebook toward plot design, equipment operation, data analysis, and forest-management support. Equipment and data skills carry more value than basic form filling.
ai_s2_auto: Automated area estimates from remote sensing
ai_s3_list: Field judgment: people still walk and interpret the terrain.
Plot placement: people select representative locations.
Fire-risk assessment: experience guides decisions.
Equipment maintenance: people diagnose field failures.
Data calibration: people investigate anomalies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career at moderate AI exposure. Systems accelerate routine mapping, while field execution and judgment still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. Technology replaces walking routes solely to record observations, not the need to measure forests accurately. Technicians who operate drones and GIS and analyze data become more valuable as productivity rises. Roles limited to paper records face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin with vocational or associate-level study in forestry or environmental protection. Develop GIS and drone skills early instead of relying only on field forms.
Move from patrol work toward equipment and data responsibilities. Learn remote sensing and GIS, and pursue project-based roles.
Emphasize both field and data experience. Name the equipment and systems you can operate.
Hire people who can work in the field and use technical systems. Physical stamina alone is insufficient; data analysis strengthens performance.

ai_s7_trends: Remote sensing and drones are becoming common, reducing routine patrol work.
Carbon-sink forests are increasing monitoring demand.
Technicians with data and equipment skills are in stronger demand.

body: Forest And Conservation Technicians assist foresters and conservation managers with forest inventories, ecological monitoring, fire-risk patrols, reforestation, and maintenance. They provide frontline data and technical support for forest management and conservation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Drones can survey a forest from the air, but technicians still decide where to place plots, how to measure trees, and how to assess fire risk on the ground.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 无人机能飞着看林子，但哪块要布样地、树怎么量、火险怎么判，还是技术员落地。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年技术员在岗约 3.38 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.27 万人，岗位净减约 0.11 万个，年均产生约 0.39 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.43 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代森林与保护技术员，但会压缩「纯跑腿记录」的环节。遥感、无人机和 GIS 把巡护与测绘提速，技术员从「走路记录」转向「布样地、操作设备、分析数据、支撑经营」。会设备会数据的人更值钱，只会记表的人被挤。
ai_s3_list: 现场判断：地形靠人走。
样地布设：选点靠人定。
火险研判：经验靠人。
设备运维：故障靠人。
数据校准：异常靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——常规测绘被系统加速，但户外落地与判断还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「走路记录」动作，不是「把林子量准」的岗位。会操作无人机和 GIS、能分析数据的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会拿本子记的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 林业/环保类中职大专起步，早点练 GIS 和无人机，别只会记表。
从巡护升级成「设备 + 数据」，学遥感和 GIS，争取项目岗。
突出户外与数据经验，写清会用哪些设备与系统。
选人看能不能落地又会系统，光有力气不够，能分析数据更稳。

ai_s7_trends: 遥感无人机普及，常规巡护缩。
碳汇林带动监测需求。
会数据会设备的人更抢手。

body: 森林与保护技术员协助林业师与保护管理者，开展森林资源调查、生态监测、火险巡查与造林管护，是林业经营和保护的一线数据与技术支撑。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 无人机能飞着看林子，但哪块要布样地、树怎么量、火险怎么判，还是技术员落地。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Drones can fly past every tower and return high-resolution images, but when a line breaks, experience and courage still determine whether and how a lineworker climbs and works it live.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 127,400 electrical power-line installers and repairers employed in 2024, projected to reach 135,800 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 8,400 jobs, with roughly 10,700 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $92,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace electrical lineworkers, but it will take over repetitive inspection work. Drone inspection, AI image-based defect detection, and line-condition analysis are replacing tower-by-tower human checks. Climbing, stringing and splicing lines, and emergency live-line repair still require hands-on skill and courage that machines cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: Pilots of live-line robots and assistive tools
Fault-location systems rapidly narrow the repair area
ai_s2_auto: Drone inspection replaces manual tower-by-tower checks
AI image recognition automatically labels line defects
Digital inspection records and defect registers
Automatic aggregation of line-condition monitoring data
ai_s3_list: Climbing work and physical endurance: working steadily more than ten meters above ground requires practiced skill.
Courage and technique for live-line work: on-site operations under insulation protection allow no uncertainty.
On-site fault judgment: an image can show a broken line, but the cause and repair method require field inspection.
Safety-procedure execution: voltage testing, grounding, and supervision are all indispensable.
Extreme-weather repair: organizing fieldwork in wind and rain depends on team coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score reflects the substantial share of inspection, recording, and analysis in this occupation, tasks drones and AI are rapidly taking over.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI makes inspection efficient and shifts people toward higher-value fieldwork. Repetitive tower-climbing inspection roles face pressure, while lineworkers who perform live-line work, understand equipment, and lead crews remain scarce.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Electrical-power programs or technical-school linework tracks provide a direct route. Master safety rules and electrical fundamentals and build fitness. In the AI era, learn drone and data-analysis tools instead of relying only on climbing, and work toward live-line expertise.

Use drone inspection and AI defect recognition instead of resisting new technology. Earn live-line qualifications, advance toward technician or crew leader, and watch renewable-energy transmission projects for growth.

People with electrical or mechanical backgrounds have an advantage when transitioning. Start as a lineworker apprentice or helper, earn climbing and electrician credentials, and describe experience such as participating in specific kilometers of line construction or repair.

Hire first for safety habits and then for technical skill; people who cannot follow procedures cannot climb towers. Hybrid workers who operate drones, understand data, and perform live-line work merit better compensation and growth opportunities.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatically label damaged insulators and other image findings
Platform for live-line and de-energized work
Overlay drawings and procedures on site

ai_s7_trends: Drone plus AI inspection becomes standard, reducing demand for inspection-only labor while raising the value of fieldwork roles.
Grid upgrades and renewable-energy transmission projects create growth, favoring talent in live-line work and intelligent maintenance.
Safety oversight and training become stricter, making credentials and hands-on ability the industry's dividing line.

body: Electrical power-line installers and repairers construct, install, inspect, maintain, and repair transmission and distribution lines. They set poles, string conductors, replace insulators, and perform live-line work to keep power lines safe and reliable.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Drones can fly past every tower and return high-resolution images, but when a line breaks, experience and courage still determine whether and how a lineworker climbs and works it live.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 无人机能飞遍每座塔拍回高清照片，但断线那一刻要不要带电上塔、怎么上，还得靠线路工的经验和胆量。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电力线路安装维修人员在岗约 12.74 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 13.58 万人，净增约 0.84 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.07 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.26 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代电力线路工，但会接管巡线里的重复活。无人机巡检、AI 图像识别缺陷、线路状态分析，正在替代「人爬塔挨个看」。剩下的登高作业、架线接续、带电抢修，是现场的手艺和胆量，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 分析预测线路故障风险
带电作业机器人与辅助工具试点
AR 辅助定位与施工指导
故障定位系统快速缩小抢修范围
ai_s2_auto: 无人机巡检替代人工逐塔查看
AI 图像识别自动标注线路缺陷
巡检记录与缺陷台账电子化
线路状态监测数据自动汇总
ai_s3_list: 登高作业与体力耐力：十几米高空稳着手干活，是练出来的功夫。
带电作业胆量与手法：绝缘防护下的临场操作，容不得半点含糊。
现场故障判断：照片能看出断线，但为什么断、怎么修，得看现场。
安全规程执行：验电、接地、监护，一环都不能少。
极端天气抢修：风里雨里的现场组织，靠的是队伍默契。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的巡线、记录、分析比重不小，这些正被无人机和 AI 快速接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 让巡线变高效，反而把人力推向「更高价值」的现场作业。真正被挤压的是「纯爬塔巡线」的重复岗，会带电作业、懂设备、能带队的线路工依然稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 电力专业或技校线路方向是正路，把安规、电工基础学扎实，练好体能。AI 时代别只当「会爬塔」的人，学会用无人机和数据分析，往带电作业专家方向走。
把无人机巡检、AI 缺陷识别用起来，别排斥新技术。考带电作业资格，往技术员、班长方向走；同时关注新能源送出线路工程，那里是增量。
有电气、机械背景者转型有优势。从线路工学徒或辅工做起，考登高与电工证，简历里多写「参与过XX公里线路架设/抢修」这类经历。
招线路工先看安全习惯再看技术——规程都守不住的人不能上塔。会无人机、懂数据、能带电作业的复合型人才，值得给更好的待遇和成长空间。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 高空拍照、缺陷影像采集
图像自动标注绝缘子破损等
部分高空重复操作自动化

ai_s7_trends: 无人机 + AI 巡检成为标配，纯巡线人力需求下降，现场作业岗价值上升。
电网改造与新能源送出工程带来增量，带电作业与智能化运维人才更吃香。
安全监管与培训体系趋严，持证与实操能力成为行业分水岭。

body: 电力线路安装维修人员负责输配电线路的架设、安装、巡检、检修与故障抢修，包括电杆立设、导线架设、绝缘子更换与带电作业，保障电力线路安全可靠运行。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 无人机能飞遍每座塔拍回高清照片，但断线那一刻要不要带电上塔、怎么上，还得靠线路工的经验和胆量。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can automate modeling and monitoring, but engineers still decide how to design the mine, assess safety, and respond on-site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 7,000 mining and geological engineers, including mining safety engineers, employed in 2024, projected to remain at 7,000 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 0 jobs, with roughly 400 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $101,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace mining and geological engineers, but it will accelerate modeling. Digital systems are taking over geological modeling and monitoring, shifting engineers from drawing toward mine design, safety judgment, field response, and environmental oversight. People who only model face displacement, while those with design expertise become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Mine design: people define the architecture.
Safety judgment: people provide experience.
Field response: people make decisions.
Environmental oversight: people ensure rigor.
Cross-domain coordination: people align stakeholders.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score places this occupation in a medium-to-high-exposure segment of mining. Systems accelerate modeling, but people retain responsibility for design and safety.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces modeling tasks, not mine-design roles. People who can design operations and protect safety become scarcer as efficiency rises, while those limited to modeling face risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with geology / mining and practice design extensively. Pure modeling is shrinking in the AI era, so develop safety expertise early.
Advance from drawing to design + safety management. Learn monitoring and environmental protection and pursue roles at major mines.
Highlight design and safety experience and specify which mining areas you managed. Mining companies value stability and accountability.
Do not select candidates solely by education; assess whether they think seriously about safety. Core employees who maintain zero accidents deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Digitalization spreads, reducing modeling work.
Design and safety create opportunities.
People who maintain safety are more sought after.

body: Mining and Geological Engineers, Including Mining Safety Engineers, design mine-development and geological plans, coordinating mining areas, ground support, ventilation, and environmental protection and applying geology and mechanics to extract resources safely and economically.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can automate modeling and monitoring, but engineers still decide how to design the mine, assess safety, and respond on-site.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能自动建模和监测，但采场怎么设计、安全怎么判、现场怎么处置，还是工程师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年采矿与地质工程师（含矿山安全工程师）在岗约 0.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.70 万人，净增约 0.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.04 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.10 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代采矿地质工程师，但会加速建模环节。数字化接管地质建模与监测，工程师从「画图」挪向「采场设计、安全判断、现场处置与环保把关」。真正被挤掉的是只做建模的人，有设计力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 采场设计：架构靠人。
安全判断：经验靠人。
现场处置：决断靠人。
环保把关：严谨靠人。
跨域协调：对齐靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的矿业区——建模被系统加速，但设计与安全还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「做建模」动作，不是「采场设计」的岗位。有设计力、能保安全的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做建模的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 地质 / 采矿起步多练设计，AI 时代纯建模在缩，早点练安全。
从「画图」升级成「做设计 + 管安全」，学监测与环保，争取大矿。
突出设计与安全经历，写清管过哪些采场。矿企看重稳和责。
选人别只看学历，要看有没有安全脑子。能保零事故的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 数字化普及，建模缩。
设计与安全带来机会。
能保安全的更抢手。

body: 采矿与地质工程师（含矿山安全工程师）设计矿山开采与地质方案，统筹采场、支护、通风与环保，运用地质与力学实现资源的安全经济开采。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能自动建模和监测，但采场怎么设计、安全怎么判、现场怎么处置，还是工程师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate accompaniment and music libraries, but therapists still assess emotions, build therapeutic relationships, and adapt interventions in real time.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 56,100 therapists employed in 2024, projected to rise to 62,500 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 6,400 jobs, with roughly 4,100 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $65,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace music therapists, but it will provide support. Generative music and accompaniment tools accelerate material preparation, shifting therapists from finding songs toward assessment, empathy, intervention design, and therapeutic alliance. People who only play recordings face displacement, while clinicians with empathy become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Clinical assessment: people judge the patient's condition.
Therapeutic relationships: people build trust.
Real-time adaptation: people control the rhythm.
Empathetic response: people receive the emotion.
Interdisciplinary coordination: people build the plan.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this occupation in a medium-AI-exposure category. Systems accelerate materials and records, but people retain responsibility for assessment and empathy.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces playing recordings, not providing therapy. People with clinical expertise and empathy become scarcer as efficiency rises, while therapists who only play songs without assessment face risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build foundations in both music and psychology, and plan early for a master's degree and certification. Pure performance work is shrinking in the AI era.
Advance from leading activities to assessment + treatment-plan design, and learn digital recordkeeping.
Highlight casework and institutional experience and specify the populations you have served. Organizations value practical delivery.
Do not assess candidates solely by musical ability; determine whether they think clinically. Core staff who assess clients independently deserve senior roles.

ai_s7_trends: Generative tools spread, accelerating material preparation.
Mental-health and rehabilitation demand rises.
Therapists with clinical expertise are more sought after.

body: Music therapists use music as a clinical intervention to design individualized plans for people with emotional, developmental, neurological, or age-related needs and improve speech, movement, emotional, and social functioning.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate accompaniment and music libraries, but therapists still assess emotions, build therapeutic relationships, and adapt interventions in real time.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能生成伴奏和曲库，但评估情绪、建立治疗关系、临场调整，还是治疗师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年治疗师在岗约 5.61 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.25 万人，净增约 0.64 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.41 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.50 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代音乐治疗师，但会做辅助。生成式音乐与伴奏工具提速素材准备，治疗师从「找曲子」挪向「评估、共情、设计与治疗联盟」。真正被挤掉的是只放录音的，有临床力能共情的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 临床评估：状态靠人判。
治疗关系：信任靠人建。
临场调整：节奏靠人控。
共情回应：情绪靠人接。
跨专业协同：方案靠人搭。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光区——素材与记录被系统加速，但评估与共情还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「放录音」动作，不是「做治疗」的岗位。有临床力、能共情的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会放曲子、不评估的治疗师。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 音乐+心理双底子，早点规划硕士与考证，AI 时代纯表演在缩。
从「带活动」升级成「做评估 + 搭方案」，学数据化记录。
突出个案与机构经验，写清服务过哪些人群。机构看重落地。
选人别只看乐器，要看有没有临床脑子。能独立评估的骨干，值得给高职级。

ai_s7_trends: 生成式普及，素材准备提速。
心理与康复需求上升。
有临床力的治疗师更抢手。

body: 音乐治疗师以音乐为临床干预媒介，为情绪、发育、神经或老年人群设计个体化方案，改善言语、运动、情绪与社交功能。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能生成伴奏和曲库，但评估情绪、建立治疗关系、临场调整，还是治疗师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can remind you when it is time to feed or change a diaper, but when a child wakes crying from a nightmare at midnight, the hand reaching out must belong to a nanny.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 991,600 nannies employed in 2024, projected to decline to 962,400 by 2034. That is a net loss of about 29,200 jobs, with roughly 160,200 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $32,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace nannies, but it will change their tools. Childcare once relied entirely on remembering each child's schedule and preferences. Now parenting apps track feeding and sleep, smart cameras help parents monitor children remotely, and AI recommends early-learning content. Feeding, soothing, and hands-on supervision still require people. Children need human warmth, not a speaker.
ai_s2_accel: Smart infant monitoring: breathing and sleep tracking with anomaly alerts
AI early-learning assistant: recommends interactive games by age in months
Domestic-service platform matching: digital resumes, background checks, and reviews
Smart-home integration: manages temperature, air purification, and secure door locks
ai_s2_auto: Childcare-tracking app: automatically records feeding, sleep, and diapers and generates reports
Smart cameras and monitoring devices: remote supervision and anomaly alerts
Complementary-food / recipe recommendations: automatically generates age-appropriate menus
Early-learning content library: recommends songs, picture books, and games on demand
ai_s3_list: Observation and judgment: recognizing whether a child feels unwell or upset comes from time spent together.
Tactile feeding and soothing skills: every child responds differently, with no standard answer for feeding or calming.
Emotional companionship and security: children need hugs and responses, warmth machines cannot provide.
Frequent parent communication: explaining what a child ate and why the child was upset in a way that reassures parents.
Emergency response: experience and composure determine the first response to falls, fever, or choking.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 3/10 score means most work happens on-site beside the child. AI can support records and reminders, but remains far from feeding, soothing, supervising, and playing with children in place of people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean no change. AI tools are reshaping the capabilities of high-end nannies. Nannies who interpret childcare data and use early-learning apps are more competitive than those who rely only on experience. Ordinary nannies who only supervise children without understanding early education or nutrition face pressure from more professional peers, not replacement by AI.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Domestic work does not require advanced education, but professional certificates are increasingly valuable. Consider infant-care and postpartum-care credentials and study infant nursing and early education. Nannies who understand evidence-based childcare and use parenting tools are more welcome in the AI era, making this a practical employment path.

Move beyond simply watching children. Build knowledge of infant nutrition, early education, and first aid, earn a certificate, and learn childcare apps. Advancing from ordinary nanny to childcare specialist can raise income significantly.

Start as an hourly worker or childcare nanny, build a reputation and client referrals, and earn an infant-care certificate. On your resume, quantify how many children you cared for, their age ranges in months, and parent renewal rates.

When hiring nannies, look beyond years of experience to certificates, first-aid ability, and communication. Emotionally stable nannies who practice evidence-based childcare and keep parents informed deserve higher pay and reduce replacement costs.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic records, periodic reports, and reminders
Breathing and sleep monitoring, anomaly alerts
Songs, picture books, and interactive-game recommendations
Resumes, background checks, reviews, and electronic contracts
Temperature, purification, and door-lock security management

ai_s7_trends: Domestic services are becoming professionally specialized. Ordinary childcare roles are narrowing, while demand rises for certified childcare specialists, early educators, and postpartum caregivers.
Parenting apps and smart monitoring are becoming standard, substantially improving the competitiveness of nannies who interpret data and use tools.
Industry standards and worker protections are gradually improving, making regulated domestic-service platforms and certified services mainstream.

body: Nannies provide daily care, meals, routines, safety supervision, and basic early education for infants and preschool children. Some live-in nannies also perform light housework, making this the domestic-service role that spends the most time with children.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can remind you when it is time to feed or change a diaper, but when a child wakes crying from a nightmare at midnight, the hand reaching out must belong to a nanny.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能提醒你该喂奶了、该换尿布了，但孩子半夜做噩梦哭醒时，伸过去的那只手，得是保姆的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年保姆在岗约 99.16 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 96.24 万人，岗位净减约 2.92 万个，年均产生约 16.02 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.21 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代保姆，但会改变「工具」这件事。以前全靠经验记孩子的作息和偏好，现在有育儿 App 记录喂养、睡眠，有智能摄像头帮家长远程看娃，有 AI 早教内容推荐。可喂饭、哄睡、看护这些贴身活，机器进不来——孩子要的是有温度的人，不是一个扬声器。
ai_s2_accel: 智能婴儿监护：呼吸、睡眠监测，异常告警
AI 早教助手：根据月龄推荐互动游戏
家政平台撮合：简历、背调、评价线上化
智能家居联动：恒温、空气净化、安全门锁管理
ai_s2_auto: 育儿记录 App：喂养、睡眠、尿布自动记录并生成报告
智能摄像头与监护设备：远程看护、异常提醒
辅食/菜谱推荐：按年龄自动生成食谱
早教内容库：儿歌、绘本、游戏按需推荐
ai_s3_list: 对孩子的观察与判断：孩子是不是不舒服、心情怎么样，一眼能看出，这是相处出来的直觉。
喂养与哄睡的手感：每个孩子的脾气都不一样，怎么喂、怎么哄，没有标准答案。
情感陪伴与安全感：孩子要抱抱、要回应，这种温度机器给不了。
与家长的高频沟通：孩子今天吃得怎样、为什么闹，要讲得家长放心。
突发情况的处置：磕碰、发烧、异物卡喉，第一时间怎么处理，靠的是经验和冷静。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业绝大多数工作在现场、在孩子身边——喂饭、哄睡、看护、陪玩，AI 能辅助记录和提醒，但离「替人带孩子」还很远。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低曝光不等于没变化。AI 工具正在重塑「高端保姆」的能力模型：会看育儿数据、会用早教 App 的保姆，比纯凭经验的更有竞争力。真正被挤压的是「只会看娃、不懂早教营养」的普通保姆——不是被 AI 取代，是被更专业的同行取代。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 家政不需要高学历，但专业证书越来越值钱。建议考育婴师、月嫂证，学婴幼儿护理和早教。AI 时代，懂科学育儿、会用育儿工具的保姆更受欢迎，这是条不错的就业路。
别停留在「会看娃」。把婴幼儿营养、早教、急救知识补起来，考个证、学用育儿 App，从「普通保姆」升级为「育儿师」，收入能上一个台阶。
先从钟点工或育儿嫂做起，攒口碑拿客户推荐，同时考育婴师证。简历上写「照顾过几个孩子、带的月龄范围、家长续约率」这类可量化成果。
招保姆别只看经验年限，要看证书、急救能力和沟通。能科学育儿、会跟家长同步孩子情况、情绪稳定的保姆，值得给更高薪酬，减少换人成本。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 自动记录、周期报告、提醒
呼吸睡眠监测、异常告警
按月龄推荐食谱、过敏提醒
儿歌、绘本、互动游戏推荐
简历、背调、评价、电子合同
恒温、净化、门锁安全管理
海姆立克、心肺复苏步骤查询
身高体重、发育里程碑记录

ai_s7_trends: 家政服务走向「专业化细分」，普通看娃岗位收窄，持证育儿师、早教师、月嫂需求上升。
育儿 App 与智能监护成为标配，会看数据、会用工具的保姆竞争力明显提升。
行业标准与职业保障逐步完善，规范化的家政平台和持证服务成为主流。

body: 保姆（Nannies）负责婴幼儿与学龄前儿童的日常照料、饮食起居、安全看护和基础早教，部分住家保姆还兼顾简单家务，是家政服务行业里与孩子相处时间最长的照护岗位。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can identify suspicious targets across vast amounts of surveillance footage, but the officer at the scene still makes the final call on whether a dispute can be resolved on the spot or requires an escalated response.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 698,800 police officers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 720,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 22,000 jobs, with approximately 53,700 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $76,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace patrol officers: field enforcement requires legal authority and human judgment, conflict de-escalation depends on communication experience, and only police can exercise the authority to use force. AI can greatly improve surveillance analysis, paperwork, and intelligence assessment, but machines cannot replace being physically present and standing face-to-face with the people involved.
ai_s2_accel: AI facial recognition and target matching
AI-assisted interview records and evidence organization
ai_s2_auto: Assisted automatic generation of written reports
Digitized household registration and records management
ai_s3_list: On-scene response: making rapid judgments before a conflict escalates.
Communication and mediation: knowing what to say to calm the parties involved.
Legal judgment: determining which law applies in each situation.
Situational adaptability: responding to sudden violence and dangerous scenarios.
Accountability: taking responsibility for the consequences of enforcement actions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 shows that patrol officers occupy a position where AI clearly improves efficiency but cannot replace the core role: AI is taking over much of surveillance, paperwork, and intelligence work, while frontline officers retain discretion over field enforcement, mediation, and the use of force.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: A midrange score means officers should learn proactively: those who can use big-data intelligence and investigation tools handle cases more efficiently and have better promotion prospects, while veteran officers indifferent to digital policing will gradually be assigned to support roles.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If your child wants to become a police officer, first assess the education, physical fitness, and political screening requirements for police recruitment exams. Make it clear that this is not a glamorous job, but a combination of shift work, danger, and pressure. Building fitness and learning about the public security joint examination early are recommended, and those with poor psychological resilience should think carefully.

Learn digital skills such as big-data investigations and electronic forensics, which are essential assets for a new generation of officers. At the same time, build a strong reputation in community policing and public engagement, grassroots capital that AI cannot provide.

People transferring from other systems into policing generally need to take the recruitment exam again. Veterans and candidates with backgrounds in law or psychology have an advantage; interviews and assessments should emphasize resilience under pressure, discipline, and communication skills.

Police staffing shortages are widespread, and simply adding authorized positions is unrealistic. Equipping frontline officers with smart devices and big-data tools, freeing them from repetitive paperwork and patrol duties, is the only way to genuinely improve response effectiveness and retention.

ai_s7_trends: Digital policing and big-data investigations are becoming standard approaches to casework.
Surveillance and AI technologies are strengthening preventive policing.
Community policing and police-community relations continue to gain importance.

body: Patrol officers patrol designated jurisdictions, respond to calls, handle public-order cases, traffic accidents, and requests for assistance, conduct stops, mediation, and preliminary investigations, and maintain public safety and legal order.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在海量监控里锁定可疑目标，但「眼前这个争执能不能就地化解、要不要升级处置」——最后拍板的还是现场的警察。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年警察官在岗约 69.88 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 72.08 万人，净增约 2.20 万个岗位，年均产生约 5.37 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.63 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代巡逻警察：现场执法需要法律授权和人的判断，冲突化解依赖沟通经验，使用武力更是只有警察能行使的权力。AI 能大幅提升监控分析、文书处理和情报研判，但「出现在现场、站在当事人面前」这件事，机器替不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 人脸识别与目标比对
智能巡逻与无人机辅助
AI 辅助笔录与证据整理
ai_s2_auto: 文书报告自动生成辅助
户籍与档案管理信息化
ai_s3_list: 现场处置：冲突升级前的快速判断。
沟通调解：让当事人冷静下来的话术。
法律判断：什么情况用哪条法规。
临场应变：突发暴力与危险场景的应对。
责任担当：执法行为的后果承担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明巡警处于「AI 明显提效、但替代不了核心」的位置：监控、文书、情报被 AI 大幅接管，而现场执法、调解和武力使用的裁量权，依然由一线警察掌控。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中分意味着要主动学习：会用大数据情报和大数据侦查工具的民警，办案效率和晋升机会都更好；对数字化警务无感的老民警，会慢慢被安排在辅助性岗位。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 孩子想当警察，先过招警考试的学历、体能和政审关。要讲清楚：这不是「威风」的职业，是倒班、危险和压力的集合体；建议提前练体能、了解公安联考，心理素质差的要慎重。
把大数据侦查、电子取证这些数字化技能学起来，这是新一代民警的硬通货。同时经营好社区警务，和群众打交道的口碑，是 AI 给不了你的基层资本。
从其他系统转警务的一般要重新考录。退役军人、有法律和心理学背景的更有优势；面试和考核中突出抗压能力、纪律性和沟通能力。
警力紧张是普遍问题，靠增加编制不现实。给一线民警配智能化装备和大数据工具，把民警从重复的文书和巡逻中解放出来，才能真正提升处置效能和留人率。

ai_s7_trends: 数字化警务与大数据侦查成为办案主流。
监控与 AI 技术提升预防警务能力。
社区警务与警民关系建设持续加强。

body: 巡逻警察在划定的辖区进行巡逻防控与接处警，处理治安案件、交通事故与群众求助，开展盘查、调解与初步调查，维护公共安全与法律秩序。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated sorting can route mail correctly, but the postmaster still relies on experience to decide which branch has too many complaints and whose shift needs changing today.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 13,100 postmasters and mail superintendents were employed in 2024, falling to a projected 12,700 by 2034, a net decrease of about 400 jobs, with approximately 900 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $92,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postmasters, but it will support operations. Sorting, scheduling, and routing systems accelerate routine work, shifting postmasters from shift records toward branch management + customer communication + exception decisions. People who only schedule shifts face displacement, while those who manage branches and resolve complaints become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Branch management: people keep operations running.
Customer communication: people calm dissatisfied customers.
Exception decisions: people decide how to handle emergencies.
Team leadership: people sustain team performance.
Community touchpoints: people build relationships.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates that this occupation sits in a management area with moderate AI exposure. Systems accelerate sorting and scheduling, while branch management remains human-led.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: shift scheduling and recordkeeping tasks are replaced, not the role of managing branches and customer complaints. People who can manage and communicate become scarcer as systems expand. Those who only record schedules face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start on the front line and develop management and communication skills. Pure scheduling roles are shrinking in the AI era, so learn to lead people early.
Advance from scheduling to branch management + complaint resolution, and learn operations and system tools.
Highlight branch management and customer complaint cases, including the size of the area you managed.
Do not select people solely by seniority; assess whether they can manage branches and lead teams. Postmasters who maintain service quality are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Electronic communications replace letter mail, reducing volume.
Sorting and scheduling are moving onto systems.
Postmasters who manage branches and communicate well have greater stability.

body: Postmasters and mail superintendents manage the operations of post offices and mail processing centers. They schedule delivery and window shifts, maintain successful-delivery rates and service standards, handle complaints, and coordinate upper-level targets with subordinate branches.
