ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动分拣能按路向走件，但哪个网点投诉多、谁今天该调班，还是局长凭经验定的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年邮政局长邮件主管在岗约 1.31 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.27 万人，岗位净减约 0.04 万个，年均产生约 0.09 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.27 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代邮政局长，但会辅助运营。分拣、调度与路由系统把事务提速，局长从「排班记录」挪向「网点管理 + 客户沟通 + 异常决策」。真正被挤掉的是只做排班的人，会管网点能处投诉的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 网点管理：运转靠人管。
客户沟通：投诉靠人抚。
异常决策：突发靠人定。
团队带领：状态靠人带。
社区触点：关系靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的管理区——分拣调度被系统提速，网点管理还留人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「排班与记录」动作，不是「管网点和客诉」的岗位。会管理、能沟通的人反而随系统化更稀缺。怕的是只会记排班的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 从一线做起，练管理和沟通。AI 时代纯排班在缩，早点练带人。
从「排班」升级成「管网点 + 处投诉」，学运营和系统工具。
突出管网点和客诉案例，写清管过多大片区。
选人别只看资历，看能不能管网点带人。能守服务的局长值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 电子件替代平信，量下滑。
分拣调度上系统。
会管网点能沟通的局长更稳。

body: 邮政局长与邮件主管管理邮局与邮件处理中心的运营，安排投递与窗口班次，把控妥投率与服务标准，处理投诉并对接上级指标与下属网点。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动分拣能按路向走件，但哪个网点投诉多、谁今天该调班，还是局长凭经验定的。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can write a literature review in ten minutes, but teachers still provide the academic judgment on whether a research design is sound and how to mentor a student.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 52,500 postsecondary psychology teachers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 54,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,900 jobs, with approximately 4,000 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $80,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary psychology teachers, but it will take over repetitive teaching preparation and research tasks. AI increasingly handles slide generation, literature organization, data analysis, and first drafts. Classroom teaching, research design, academic judgment, and student mentoring remain human strengths that machines cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted research design and experiment-program generation
New paradigms for big-data psychology research
AI teaching assistants answering questions and providing assignment feedback
Tools assisting research writing and journal submission
ai_s2_auto: Generate first drafts of slides and lesson plans
Automatically run statistical analyses and create charts
ai_s3_list: Research-design judgment: selecting the right statistical method and determining whether an experiment can test the hypothesis are core skills.
Classroom teaching: making students' eyes light up while explaining abstract theory depends on live communication.
Student mentoring: revising papers, guiding experiments, and easing academic anxiety require one-on-one expertise.
Academic ethics and judgment: people must decide how far data can be used and how strongly conclusions can be stated.
Disciplinary perspective: connecting fragmented studies into a coherent system requires academic intuition built over time.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 reflects the occupation's substantial literature, statistics, and writing workload, which AI is rapidly taking over.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI makes research easier to begin, shifting value toward judgment and creativity. Choosing the right topic, designing a sound study, and defending conclusions depend on human academic expertise. Formulaic, low-value publishing faces pressure, while rigorous researchers become scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Prepare for doctoral study if you want a university career; research universities generally require a doctorate plus overseas experience. Choose a direction early in graduate school and join projects. Do not focus only on the imagined ease of teaching, because academia is a marathon.

Use AI for literature, statistics, and writing, leaving time for high-quality research and student mentoring. While meeting assessment targets, commit deeply to one direction capable of producing genuine results rather than spreading effort widely.

Applied psychology and mental health roles are expanding and offer relatively accessible university entry. Candidates with industry experience in business or counseling have distinct advantages as applied instructors. Emphasize achievements in courses, research projects, and mentoring.

Do not hire teachers solely by publication count; assess academic judgment and teaching potential. Ask candidates to explain a research design they want to pursue but have not yet conducted. Comprehensive talent that teaches, researches, and mentors students deserves the greatest investment.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Online experiments and behavioral data collection
Lab meetings, documents, and project management

ai_s7_trends: As AI takes over teaching preparation and research workflows, faculty focus shifts to research judgment, instructional design, and student development.
Total university openings are tightening, while applied psychology and mental health expand and up-or-out pressure continues.
AI is restructuring research paradigms, increasing recognition for researchers who master new methods and produce genuine results.

body: Postsecondary psychology teachers teach psychology courses at universities and vocational colleges while conducting research, guiding graduate and undergraduate students, supporting academic service, and promoting public knowledge.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can write a literature review in ten minutes, but teachers still provide the academic judgment on whether a research design is sound and how to mentor a student.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能十分钟写完一份文献综述，但「这个研究设计靠不靠谱、这个学生该怎么带」的学术判断，还得靠老师。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校心理学教师在岗约 5.25 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.44 万人，净增约 0.19 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.40 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.03 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校心理学教师，但会接管备课与科研里的重复活。课件生成、文献整理、数据统计、论文初稿，这些正被 AI 快速代劳。剩下的课堂教学、研究设计、学术判断、学生指导，是人的核心，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助研究设计与实验程序生成
大数据心理学研究的新范式
AI 助教答疑与作业反馈
科研写作与投稿的辅助工具
ai_s2_auto: 统计分析自动执行与出图
ai_s3_list: 研究设计判断：统计方法选得对不对、实验能不能回答假设，是核心功力。
课堂教学：把抽象的理论讲得学生眼睛发亮，靠的是现场表达。
学生指导：改论文、带实验、疏导学术焦虑，一对一的手艺。
学术伦理与判断：数据可用到什么程度、结论下到什么分寸，要拿捏。
学科视野：把零散研究串成体系，是长期积累的学术直觉。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的文献、统计、写作比重不小，这些正被 AI 快速接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 让科研「上手」变快，反而把价值推向「判断与创造」——选题准不准、设计好不好、结论站不站得住，靠的是人的学术功力。真正被挤压的是「只会套模板灌水」的产出方式，扎实的研究者反而更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想进高校就得做好读博准备，研究型院校普遍要求博士加海外经历。读研时尽早定方向、多参与课题，别只盯着「当老师」的轻松想象——学术路是一条长跑。
把 AI 用在文献、统计和写作上，省下时间做高质量研究和学生指导。盯紧考核指标的同时，选一个能出真成果的方向深耕，别四处撒网。
应用心理、心理健康方向的岗位在扩编，是进入高校的相对洼地。有行业经验（企业、咨询）者做应用型教师有独特优势，简历里多写「课程、课题、指导」三类成果。
招教师别只看论文数量，要看学术判断和教学潜力。面试时让候选人讲一个「想做但还没做」的研究设计，能看出真功力；能教学、能科研、能带学生的综合型人才最值得投入。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 在线实验与行为数据采集

ai_s7_trends: AI 全面接管备课与科研流程，教师的精力转向研究判断、教学设计与学生培养。
高校岗位总量趋紧，应用心理与心理健康方向扩编，非升即走压力持续。
AI 时代研究范式重构，能驾驭新方法、出真成果的研究者更受认可。

body: 高校心理学教师在大学及职业院校从事心理学相关课程的教学工作，同时开展心理学研究、指导研究生与本科生、参与学术服务和知识普及。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能十分钟写完一份文献综述，但「这个研究设计靠不靠谱、这个学生该怎么带」的学术判断，还得靠老师。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI cameras can scan an entire production line's appearance in one second, but the insistence on testing again and asking why something failed still has to come from you.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 83,200 quality control inspectors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 86,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,000 jobs, with about 10,600 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $60,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace quality control inspectors, but it will change how they work. AI vision and systems are taking over visual inspection, dimensional measurement, and data recording, shifting inspectors from checkers to quality analysts. Sampling plans, interpretation of standards, anomaly tracing, and continuous improvement cannot be replaced by machines. Inspectors who understand data and analysis become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Continually improving AI visual inspection accuracy
Real-time analysis on quality data platforms
ai_s3_list: Sampling plan judgment: statistical thinking determines how much and how to sample.
Standards interpretation: borderline cases require both rigor and reasonableness.
Anomaly tracing: analyze root causes of nonconforming products back to the source.
Driving improvement: turn inspection findings into process improvements through communication and coordination.
Responsibility and principles: declare failures and withstand pressure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 means AI and systems are taking over more than half of inspection and recordkeeping tasks. Machines are faster at appearance, dimensions, and data.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI takes over detection, leaving analysis, including sampling, interpretation, tracing, and improvement, even more important. Purely visual inspection roles are shrinking, while inspectors who understand data and analysis become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Mechanical, materials, chemical, food, or quality management education is the standard route. Emphasize laboratory work and statistics and practice both instrument use and data analysis.
Use AI inspection and quality data platforms, learn SPC and root cause analysis, and earn quality engineer credentials. Advance from inspector to quality analyst + improvement driver.
People with manufacturing or laboratory backgrounds learn quickly and can start as inspectors. On your resume, specify the products you inspected, gauges you used, and improvements you drove.
When hiring inspectors, look beyond speed and visual acuity to data analysis and integrity. Candidates who interpret quality data and uphold standards are the rarest.

ai_s7_trends: As AI vision and automated measurement spread, inspectors shift from inspection to data analysis + quality improvement, making statistics a foundational skill.
Digital quality traceability increases inspectors' interaction with end-to-end data.
Roles advance toward quality engineering and systems management, increasing demand for inspectors who understand data and drive improvements.

body: Quality control inspectors inspect products and raw materials. They sample according to standards, measure and test with gauges and instruments, determine conformity, record data and issue reports, and participate in anomaly tracing and quality improvement.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI cameras can scan an entire production line's appearance in one second, but the insistence on testing again and asking why something failed still has to come from you.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 摄像头能一秒扫完一整个产线的外观，但那个「再测一遍」的坚持和「为什么不合格」的追问，还得是你。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年质量控制检查员在岗约 8.32 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 8.62 万人，净增约 0.30 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.06 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.01 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代质量控制检查员，但会改变工作方式。外观检测、尺寸测量、数据记录正被 AI 视觉和系统接管，检查员从「检验员」转向「质量分析师」——抽样方案、标准裁量、异常追溯和持续改进，是机器替代不了的。懂数据、会分析的检查员反而更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 视觉检测精度持续提升
质量数据平台实时分析
SPC 统计过程控制自动化
可追溯系统全链路数字化
ai_s2_auto: 外观检测 AI 视觉化
ai_s3_list: 抽样方案判断：抽多少、怎么抽，统计思维靠人。
标准裁量：边界案例判不判，既要严格也要合理。
异常追溯：不合格品的根因分析，追到源头。
改进推动：把检验发现变成流程改进，沟通协调。
责任与原则：敢说不合格，扛得住压力。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有超过一半的检测与记录任务正被 AI 和系统接管——外观、尺寸、数据，机器都比人快。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接管的是「检测」环节，留下的是「分析」环节——抽样、裁量、追溯和改进反而更重要。真正被压缩的是纯目检岗，懂数据、会分析的检查员更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机械、材料、化工、食品或质量管理专业是正路，重视实验课和统计基础。把量具仪器和数据分析都练起来。
把 AI 检测和质量数据平台用起来，学 SPC 与根因分析，考质量工程师证书。从「检验员」升级为「质量分析师+改进推动者」。
有制造或实验背景上手快，可从检验员做起。简历多写「检验过哪些产品、用过哪些量具、推动过什么改进」。
招检查员别只看手快眼尖，要看数据分析和原则性。能读懂质量数据、又敢坚持标准的候选人，是最稀缺的。

ai_s7_trends: AI 视觉与自动测量普及，检查员从「检验」转向「数据分析+质量改进」，统计能力成为基本功。
质量追溯数字化，检查员与全链路数据打交道的比重上升。
岗位向「质量工程师、体系管理」升级，懂数据、能推动改进的检查员更抢手。

body: 质量控制检查员负责产品与原料的质量检验，包括按抽样标准取样、使用量具与仪器测量检测、判定合格与否、记录数据出具报告，以及参与异常追溯与质量改进。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 摄像头能一秒扫完一整个产线的外观，但那个「再测一遍」的坚持和「为什么不合格」的追问，还得是你。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Closed-loop thickness control can automatically set the roll gap precisely, but people are still needed to reinstall rolls and adjust dies when changing specifications.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 22,500 rolling machine setters, operators, and tenders for metal and plastic were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 20,600 by 2034, a net decrease of about 1,900 jobs, with approximately 1,900 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $48,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace rolling machine workers, but it will take over closed-loop thickness and tension control. Automated control systems stabilize dimensions, shifting operators from manually adjusting roll gaps toward installing rolls, changing dies, monitoring anomalies, managing multiple machines, and troubleshooting. People who only watch screens without adjusting equipment will be displaced, while those who can install rolls and troubleshoot faults will become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Digital twins simulate rolling and energy consumption
Predictive maintenance alerts for roll-system replacement
Computer vision inspects flatness and surface defects
ai_s2_auto: Automated closed-loop thickness and tension control
Online thickness measurement and automated performance testing
Automated operating parameter logs and alerts
Electronic distribution of specification-change work orders and roll sequences
ai_s3_list: Roll installation and die changes: people must physically align the gap.
Exception handling: people must clear jams and strip breaks.
Equipment-adjustment intuition: people tune interacting parameters.
Multi-line monitoring: people oversee several lines at once.
First-piece approval: people determine whether output meets standards.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this occupation in a moderately high AI-exposure category for equipment tending. Systems take over closed-loop thickness control, while roll installation and die changes remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Manual roll-gap adjustment is being replaced, not roles centered on roll installation and troubleshooting. Versatile workers who can install rolls, change dies, and manage multiple machines become even scarcer as automation expands. Those who only watch screens and do no hands-on work face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through secondary vocational or associate-level study in mechatronics or materials, and gain extensive hands-on experience with equipment and drawings while in school. Machine-watching-only roles are contracting in the AI era, so develop roll installation and die-changing skills early.
Advance from watching one line to managing multiple machines and troubleshooting faults. Learn roll systems and processes, then work toward line leader or process roles.

Highlight experience installing rolls and tuning machinery, clearly stating the widths of production lines you have managed and the anomalies you have handled. Factories value people who become productive quickly.
Do not recruit solely for physical strength; assess whether candidates can install rolls and change dies. People who can troubleshoot independently deserve higher skill-based pay.

ai_s7_trends: As automated closed-loop control becomes widespread, machine-tending-only roles are consolidated and reduced.
Digital twins and computer vision further automate quality control.
Versatile workers who can install rolls and change dies are in greater demand.

body: Metal rolling workers are Rolling Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders for metal and plastic who operate rolling mills and calendering equipment, set tooling and adjust roll gaps, monitor thickness, tension, and temperature curves, take samples and measure thickness, and adjust machinery for specification changes.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Closed-loop thickness control can automatically set the roll gap precisely, but people are still needed to reinstall rolls and adjust dies when changing specifications.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 厚度闭环能把辊缝自动压准，但换规格要重新装辊调模，还是人上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器铺设工、操作员、看护员、金属塑料在岗约 2.25 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.06 万人，岗位净减约 0.19 万个，年均产生约 0.19 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.86 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代轧机工，但会接管厚度张力闭环。自动控制系统把尺寸稳住，操作员从「手动调辊缝」挪向「装辊换模、看异常、管多机、排故障」。真正被挤掉的是只盯屏不调机的人，能装辊排故的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 数字孪生模拟轧制与能耗
预测性维护提醒辊系更换
视觉检测板形与表面缺陷
ai_s2_auto: 厚度与张力的自动闭环控制
在线测厚与性能自动检测
运行参数的自动记录与报警
换规格工单与辊序的电子下发
ai_s3_list: 装辊换模：要人动手对缝。
异常处置：卡料断带要人排。
调机手感：参数耦合靠人调。
多线巡看：同时盯几条靠人。
首样判定：达标与否靠人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的设备看管区——厚度闭环被系统吃，但装辊换模留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「手动调辊缝」动作，不是「装辊排故」的岗位。能装辊换模、管多机的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。怕的是只会盯屏、不动手的老看机人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机电材料中职大专打底，在校多摸设备和图纸。AI 时代纯看机在缩，早点练装辊换模。
从「看一条」升级成「管多机 + 排故障」，学辊系和工艺，争取转机长或工艺。
突出装辊和调机经验，写清看过多宽产线、出过什么异常。厂里看重上手快。
招人别只看体力，要看会不会装辊换模。能独立排故的，值得给高技能工资。

ai_s7_trends: 自动闭环普及，纯看管岗并减。
数字孪生与视觉让质控更自动。
能装辊换模的多能工更抢手。

body: 金属轧制工是金属与塑料轧机设定、操作与看护工操作轧机与压延设备，进行工装设定与辊缝调整，监控厚度、张力与温度曲线，取样测厚并换规格调机。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 厚度闭环能把辊缝自动压准，但换规格要重新装辊调模，还是人上。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can optimize the layout and cut a piece of fabric, but a tailor's eyes and hands are still needed to recognize that the shoulder on this garment needs to be raised slightly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 38,800 tailors, dressmakers, and custom sewers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 37,100 by 2034, a net decrease of about 1,700 jobs, with approximately 5,000 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $40,900 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace tailors, but it will transform standardized steps in the sewing process. Systems can accelerate marker planning, material calculations, automated cutting, and even pattern digitization, shifting tailors' time from repetitive machine sewing toward fitting judgment, alteration after fittings, and craftsmanship quality control. The truly scarce skill is deciding what fits one specific person perfectly.
ai_s2_accel: 3D body measurement and virtual fitting to support pattern decisions
AI-generated apparel designs and style references
Automated alteration recommendations and price quotes
Smart matching of fabric inventory and supply chains
ai_s2_auto: Automated calculation of marker layouts and material requirements
Parametric generation and automated cutting of standard patterns
Machine substitution for repetitive, high-volume sewing operations
Digital management of orders, measurement records, and inventory
ai_s3_list: Measurement and pattern judgment: The same number can produce the wrong ease on a body, so fit requires visual and tactile judgment.
Fitting communication: When a customer says the waist feels uncomfortable, you must identify the exact point and determine how much to alter.
Construction details and finishing quality: Clean overlocking, matched patterns, and perfectly straight topstitching require a discerning standard that machines cannot supply.
Fabric expertise: Before cutting, tailors must know which materials will shrink, drape, or wrinkle.
Customer trust and reputation: Custom businesses depend on repeat customers earned one order at a time.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means that standardized tasks such as marker planning, material calculations, and high-volume sewing are being automated. These are precisely the tasks most common on factory production lines.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low to medium risk does not mean no change. Pure sewing jobs limited to assembly-line work are shrinking, while personalized custom and alteration services depend on tactile judgment and communication. The stronger AI becomes, the more valuable tailors who understand people will be.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Studying fashion design or patternmaking is a solid start, but do not learn only drawing and machine operation. Add fabric knowledge, pattern digitization, and apparel CAD. Tailors who combine manual craftsmanship with digital tools are more competitive.

Upgrade body measurement and patternmaking to digital tools, then invest the saved time in fitting communication and refined construction. Take on more bespoke and alteration work, because skill and reputation create pricing power.

Do not rush to open a shop. First work at a bespoke or alteration shop and build strong fundamentals in measurement and pattern alteration. A portfolio of garments you altered and customer feedback is far more useful than talking abstractly about passion.

Do not evaluate tailors solely by education. Assess how many bespoke garments or alterations they have completed independently. Craftspeople who can operate digital measurement tools while preserving handmade details deserve better compensation and room to grow.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Optimal marker layouts and high-precision cutting
Rapid data capture and body digitization
Decorative work and more efficient edge finishing

ai_s6_tools.工具: AI customer service and booking tools

ai_s7_trends: Demand for bespoke and alteration work is concentrating around service + experience. As fast fashion and large manufacturers absorb the standard ready-to-wear market, personalized service becomes scarcer.
3D body measurement and virtual fitting lower barriers to bespoke work. Measurement data can be reused and shared across stores, making differentiated craftsmanship central.
AI marker planning and automated cutting reduce factory employment, while the handmade premium in haute couture, costumes, and bridalwear continues to rise.

body: Tailors, dressmakers, and custom sewers make custom-fitted clothing or alter ready-to-wear garments for customers. Their work covers measurement, patternmaking, cutting, basting, machine sewing, and fitting adjustments, using craftsmanship to meet personalized clothing needs.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can optimize the layout and cut a piece of fabric, but a tailor's eyes and hands are still needed to recognize that the shoulder on this garment needs to be raised slightly.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把一块布按最优排料裁好，但「你这件肩膀要再抬一点」，还得靠裁缝的眼睛和手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年裁缝、定制缝纫工在岗约 3.88 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.71 万人，岗位净减约 0.17 万个，年均产生约 0.50 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.09 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代裁缝，但会改造缝制链条里标准化的一环。排料、算料、自动裁剪、甚至版型数字化都能交给系统提速，裁缝的时间从重复车缝挪向量体判断、试穿调整和工艺把关。真正稀缺的，是面对一个具体的人，做出「刚好合身」的那个决定。
ai_s2_accel: 三维量体与虚拟试衣辅助判断版型
AI 服装设计生成与款式参考
改衣方案的自动化建议与报价
面料库存与供应链的智能匹配
ai_s2_auto: 排料与算料的自动化计算
标准版型的参数化生成与自动裁剪
重复性批量车缝工序的机器替代
订单记录、尺寸档案与库存的数字化管理
ai_s3_list: 量体与版型判断：同样一个数字，落在人身上松紧对不对，要靠眼和手感。
试穿沟通：客人说「腰这里不舒服」，你得听懂是哪个点、改多少。
工艺细节与收尾质量：锁边、对格、明线笔直，机器做不出「讲究」。
面料经验：什么料会缩、会垂、会皱，剪之前心里得有数。
客户信任与口碑：定制生意靠一单单攒出来的回头客。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这行的标准化环节——排料、算料、批量车缝——正在被自动化，这些恰好是工厂流水线最常做的那部分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低-中风险不等于没变化：被压缩的是只会走流水线的纯缝制岗，而面向个人的定制和改衣服务靠的是手感和沟通，AI 越强，「懂人」的裁缝越值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学服装设计或制版专业没问题，但别只学画画和踩机子，把面料、版型数字化和服装 CAD 补上。会手工也懂工具的复合型裁缝更吃香。
把量体、打版工具升级到数字化，把省下的时间花在试穿沟通和工艺精修上。多接高级定制和改衣单，手艺和口碑才是议价资本。
别急着开店，先去定制店或改衣店做一段时间，把量体和改版的基本功练扎实。拿得出「我改过的衣服和客户反馈」比空谈热爱有用得多。
招裁缝别只看学历，要看独立完成过多少件定制或改衣。会操作数字化量体、又守得住手工细节的师傅，值得给更好的待遇和空间。

ai_s6_tools.工具: 服装 CAD 打版软件

ai_s7_trends: 定制与改衣需求向「服务 + 体验」集中，标准成衣市场被快时尚和大厂吞掉后，贴身服务反而稀缺。
三维量体与虚拟试衣让定制门槛下移，量体数据可复用、跨店协同，手艺差异化成为核心。
AI 排料与自动裁剪压缩工厂端用工，但高级定制、戏服与婚礼市场的手工溢价继续走高。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 452,300 training and development specialists were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 501,000 by 2034, a net gain of about 48,700 jobs, with about 43,900 openings annually. ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace training specialists, but it will transform productivity. Generative AI takes over courseware, assessments, and scheduling, shifting specialists from writing materials toward diagnosing needs, designing programs, and measuring outcomes. Basic courseware production will face pressure, while people who diagnose accurately and drive application will become more valuable.

ai_s3_list: Needs diagnosis: People uncover the real gaps through conversation.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderately high exposure range for training. Models can take over substantial courseware and assessment work, but diagnosis and application depend heavily on human business understanding.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces courseware production, not diagnosis and application. People who align with business needs and drive transfer will become scarcer as productivity increases.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能生成课件和测评，但「这帮人到底缺什么、怎么落地」，还得专员跟业务聊出来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年培训与发展专员在岗约 45.23 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 50.10 万人，净增约 4.87 万个岗位，年均产生约 4.39 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.58 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代培训专员，但会重做产能。生成式 AI 接手课件、测评和排课，专员从「写材料」转向「诊需求、设项目、量效果」。真正被挤掉的是基础课件生产，能诊断、能落地的人更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: 课件与讲稿的自动生成
排课与通知的自动安排
ai_s3_list: 需求诊断：真缺口要人聊。
项目设计：对齐业务要人。
现场带教：互动靠人燃。
效果落地：转化靠人推。
责任兜底：结果要人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的培训区——课件与测评能被模型大量接管，但诊断与落地高度依赖人的业务理解。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「课件生产」，不是「诊断与落地」。能对齐业务、能促转化的人，反而随产能释放更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 人力/教育底子打牢，在校多讲多练。AI 时代写课件在缩，早点练诊断和业务对齐。
从「会讲课」升级成「会诊断 + 促转化」，学 AI 工具，争取转培训经理或 OD。
突出项目和转化数据，写清服务过的业务。有业务背景优先。
招人别只看表达，要看能不能对齐业务。能促落地的人值得给高薪。

培训预算敏感，价值向业务对齐集中。
懂业务又能促转化的复合型专员更抢手。
